messages:
Anna: Quick UX/behavior question about the Console experiment creation flow — can we make routing guards more explicit in the wizard?
Kevin: +1, especially around hard guarantees (quota/fallback) vs soft routing (weights). Users keep asking where traffic goes when a variant hits quota.
Sophia: Agreed. Right now the modal only shows % splits and a tiny 'advanced' link. We should show what happens on violation: fallback model, queueing, or 429?
Basil: Current runtime behavior: if variant capacity exhausted we fallback to the default route if allowed, else we return 503. But that's opaque to the user.
Anna: Exactly. Can we show a little flow diagram or at least a short text summary in the creation UI that says: "On quota hit -> fallback to route X -> if not available, failover to base model"?
Kevin: Also need telemetry hooks. Experiment should automatically tag requests with `exp:<id>`, `variant:<name>`, and `exp_phase` (canary|ramp|stable) so dashboards can split metrics without custom instrumentation.
Sophia: I sketched a tiny copy change: "Traffic routing rules — specify the percent to send to each variant and the fallback policy if a variant is unavailable." Add a tooltip for `fallback policy` with options: `fallback-route`, `queue`, `reject` (with descriptions).
Anna: Love that. What about quotas? We have two: per-variant QPS and per-customer token budget. Should the wizard let you set both or surface only common presets?
Basil: We should surface presets (low/medium/high) + an advanced section to set numeric QPS or token caps. Runtime will enforce per-variant QPS first, then per-customer budget.
Kevin: UX concern: if someone sets variant weight to 1% but the variant has a cold-start latency penalty, we should suggest increasing min weight for better signal. Can we show an inline warning: "Variant likely cold; consider 5% minimum or use warmup rollout"?
Sophia: We can. And add a warmup toggle that runs a small internal warmup traffic burst (internal-only) before exposing to customers.
Anna: For the routing DSL, I propose we expose a readable summary and an editable JSON/YAML for power users. Example snippet to show under the advanced tab:
```yaml
experiment_id: exp-2026-03-chat-embeds
variants:
  - name: v1
    model: redwood-7b-q4
    weight: 0.95
    fallback: default
  - name: v2-canary
    model: redwood-7b-8bit
    weight: 0.05
    fallback: queue
policies:
  per_variant_qps: 50
  per_customer_tokens_per_day: 50000
  telemetry_tags: ["exp_id", "variant", "phase"]
```
Basil: That mapping looks good. Runtime needs to wire `fallback: queue` to our internal prioritized queueing so it doesn't block critical routes. I'll raise an infra PR to expose a `queue` handler in the router.
Kevin: We also need a clear change log in the UI for experiment edits (who changed weights/policies and when) — customers will A/B for months and want auditability.
Sophia: We'll show a compact timeline line under the experiment header and a link to the full audit event.
Anna: One more: abort conditions. Add simple stop rules: "stop if latency p50 increases by >20% for 10m" or "stop if error rate >1% for 5m". Should be presets + advanced expression editor.
Basil: We already emit latency/error metrics per variant, so we can wire that. I'll add a health-check watch to the rollout service that can auto-disable variants and reroute traffic.
Kevin: Great. For safety, default experiments should enable auto-stop on severe regressions. Optional toggle to opt-out.
Sophia: I'll mock a new creation flow with these elements tomorrow and post screenshots.
Anna: Awesome — thanks! @deploy-bot can you create a tracking ticket in JIRA for the console changes (experiment UI + audit + telemetry tags) + infra task for queue handler?
deploy-bot: created RED-4982 (Console: experiment creation UX & audit) and RED-4983 (Router: queue fallback handler). :white_check_mark:
Kevin: Perfect — linking the infra PR once Basil opens it.
Sophia: Quick note: include a sample query for the dashboard that teams can copy to compare variants: `sum(rate(requests_total{exp_id="%s", variant="%s"}[5m])) by (variant)`
Anna: Nice. After UX mock and infra PR we can do a short playtest with the internal release squad. :rocket:
